errors.evidence: The description provides an incomplete and incorrect list of the x-axis categories. It omits '起点', '部位', and '形状'. It also incorrectly lists '参照实体' as '显式实体' and '显式距离' as '正式距离'.
The y-axis has no visible tick marks or labels, so it is impossible to determine the tick interval. This value is hallucinated.
For the category '空间实体', the value for the gray bar (测试集) is 31.6% in the figure, not 31.0%.
For the category '事件', the value for the gray bar (测试集) is 21.7% in the figure, not 21.3%.
The chart categories are clearly sorted in descending order based on the percentage values of the '训练集' (blue bars).

The generation prompt explicitly asks to include the shortest bar's representative values, but the description only mentions the longest ones and omits the values for the shortest bars (e.g., '隐式距离' group with values around 0.1%-0.2%).
